title: track/manned/v1
description: One manned aircraft as the ANSP hands it to U-space (spec 04 §3.1, 02 F4; Reg. (EU) 2021/665 ATS.OR.127(a)), in the common envelope (04 §2): on the internal subject man.v1.<adapter>.<icao24> and as a frame of GET /v1/manned-traffic/stream. Owned by uspace-ansp (decision record M14); field names are those of 04 §3.1 in the E-13 order (§15 gap 14: alt_pressure_m, not pressure_alt_m). alt_pressure_m is pressure altitude (ISA 1013.25 hPa), never AMSL; alt_wgs84_m is geometric height above the WGS84 ellipsoid when known. state says how the aircraft ages: live, stale (no sample within the policy's stale_after_s) or source_disabled (its adapter was switched off); an aircraft is never dropped silently (CLAUDE.md rule 4). The members of the body mirror the MannedTrack component of api/openapi.yaml; a test holds them equal.

icao24.description: ICAO 24-bit address, six lower-case hex digits.

callsign.description: As broadcast, trimmed; null when unknown.

alt_pressure_m.description: Pressure altitude in metres, ISA 1013.25 hPa; not AMSL (04 §3.1).

alt_wgs84_m.description: Geometric altitude above the WGS84 ellipsoid in metres; null when the source gives none.

gs_ms.description: Ground speed in metres per second.

vrate_ms.description: Vertical rate in metres per second, positive up.

emergency.description: Emergency flag when the source carries one (Art. 10(10), 11(3)(a)); null when unknown.

squawk.description: Mode A code, four octal digits; null when unknown.

quality.description: NIC/NACp, or the adapter's quality block as received.

relevant.description: Inside a U-space volume of the CIS plus the policy margin at capture.

age_s.description: Seconds since captured_at when manned-feed wrote the frame (LESSONS B-13: an age is shown, never hidden); absent on the adapter's internal subject.
